newsitem.title: USA: Hess seen selling 1.4 mln bbls Brent crude late US.
newsitem.headline: Hess seen selling 1.4 mln bbls Brent crude late US.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude trade in the U.S. saw Amerada Hess sell 1.4 million barrels of paper Brent in the aftermarket window, traders said Tuesday.
The key buyer of the Brent was Phibro, according to trade sources, who said the U.S. trader picked-up 800,000 barrels from Hess in numerous deals between $17.99-18.05 a barrel.
The price range for aftermarket trades was 1-7 cents weaker than the IPE settlement for July Brent at $18.06 a barrel.
An inter-month Brent spread also moved at +21 cents.
